candidates.change_summary: Change the duration bound from 10_000 days to a smaller value, causing long-duration orders to revert instead of setting an expiration.
Change the expiration check from '<' to '>', reverting on expired orders but allowing expired ones through.
Change the duration arithmetic from addition to subtraction, producing a different expiration timestamp.
Change the positionExpirations index condition to use the long position id in both branches, altering which key is set for short orders.
Remove the onlyOwner guard so withdrawFees can be called by anyone.
Delete the statement that zeroes unclaimedFees[asset], so the fee balance is not cleared.
Move the external ERC20 transfer before the unclaimedFees[asset] = 0 state update.
Delete the external ERC20 transfer call so withdrawFees no longer sends the fees.
Remove the onlyOwner guard from withdrawFees so non-owners can call it.
Move the external ERC20 transfer before zeroing unclaimedFees, so the transfer executes before the fee balance is cleared.
Replace the single transfer with a self-transfer to the contract, so the recipient receives nothing.
